mapper.sql: cv.id, cv.cause, cv.create_id, cv.create_time, cv.next_deal_id, cv.total_amount, cv.status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO claim_voucher (cause, create_id, create_time, next_deal_id, total_amount, status) VALUES (#{cause}, #{createId}, #{createTime}, #{nextDealId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT , e1.id AS creator_id, e1.name AS creator_name, e1.post AS creator_post, e2.id AS dealer_id, e2.name AS dealer_name, e2.post AS dealer_post FROM claim_voucher cv LEFT JOIN employee e1 ON e1.id = cv.create_id LEFT JOIN employee e2 ON e2.id = cv.next_deal_id WHERE cv.id = #{id}

SELECT , e1.id AS creator_id, e1.name AS creator_name, e1.post AS creator_post, e2.id AS dealer_id, e2.name AS dealer_name, e2.post AS dealer_post FROM claim_voucher cv LEFT JOIN employee e1 ON e1.id = cv.create_id LEFT JOIN employee e2 ON e2.id = cv.next_deal_id WHERE cv.create_id = #{createId} ORDER BY cv.create_time DESC
